title: Redesign game_live.ex with ebook layout and context panel
description:
Phase 2: Game Client Redesign

Modify server/lib/exmud_web/live/game_live.ex:

State changes:
- Add context_entity assign (nil or entity data)
- Add compass_open assign (boolean)
- Add available_exits assign (list of directions)
- Remove command, history, history_index (no text input)

New render structure:
- Room title (.ebook-title)
- Room description prose with underlined entities
- NPCs/items as .ebook-link elements
- Event stream paragraphs
- Bottom bar with compass

Context panel (when entity clicked):
- Muted room title
- Entity description
- Action menu: Inspect, Talk, Trade, Quest, Attack, Leave

Event handlers:
- click_entity, menu_action, leave_context
- toggle_compass, navigate (for compass)
- Remove send_command and handle_keydown
